import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys
p='src/BunDomPins.lean';s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text().replace('[Q, not_forall, not_imp]','[Q, not_forall]');subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',p],input=s,text=True,check=True)
p='src/BunDomRecursion.lean';s=pathlib.Path(p).read_text();s=s[:s.index('#check')]+'''
theorem count_transport {n j : Nat} (hn : j+1 < n) (P : Asg n (j+1) → Prop) :
    Fintype.card {w // P w} =
      ∑ p : Asg n j, ∑ f : Fresh j, if P (join (p,f)) then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv (assignmentEquiv hn)
    (fun w => if P w then 1 else 0)
    (fun q => if P (join q) then 1 else 0)
    (fun w => by rw [join_split hn])]
  exact Fintype.sum_prod_type _

theorem count_recursion_full {n u j a b : Nat} (hn : j+1 < n) :
    stateCount n u (j+1) a b =
      ∑ p : Asg n j, ∑ f : Fresh j,
        if ((stf n u (j+1) (join (p,f))).1.card,
            (stf n u (j+1) (join (p,f))).2.card) = (a,b) then 1 else 0 :=
  count_transport hn _
end BunDom
''';subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py',p],input=s,text=True,check=True)
